Q: How to achieve a blend-in blur effect in React Native (CLI)? A:

Edit: I just came across this package which might work for you: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sbaiahmed1/react-native-blur It has a ProgressiveBlurView

If you can't use Skia you could try this library https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-native-progressive-blur-view

It doesn't have very many downloads so could have bugs, but it looks like the code is quite simple. If this isn't what you're looking for you could try writing something yourself by stacking multiple components from @react-native-community/blur with progressively increasing blur values and/or experimenting with @react-native-masked-view/masked-view until you get something that looks right.

Q: Split a string before and after each squared braced expression A:

After reading your revised question:

This might be what you want:

$string = 'I have a string containing [substrings] in [brackets].';
preg_split('/(\[.*?\])/', $string, null, PREG_SPLIT_DELIM_CAPTURE);

You should get:

Array
(
    [0] => I have a string containing 
    [1] => [substrings]
    [2] =>  in 
    [3] => [brackets]
    [4] => .
)

Original answer:

preg_split('/%+/i', 'ot limited to 3 %%% so it can be %%%% or % or %%%%%, etc Tha');

You should get:

Array
(
    [0] => ot limited to 3 
    [1] =>  so it can be 
    [2] =>  or 
    [3] =>  or 
    [4] => , etc Tha
)

Or if you want a mimimum of 3 then try:

preg_split('/%%%+/i', 'Not limited to 3 %%% so it can be %%%% or % or %%%%%, etc Tha');

Have a go at http://regex.larsolavtorvik.com/
